sentences.text: Metachromatic leukodystrophy due to saposin B deficiency and combined PSAP deficiency are both recorded as caused by the gene PSAP [e_316e60c8ee91] [e_b52346f0801b].
Both gene links are curated, and the second one is also backed by a published paper that describes the cause the same way [e_316e60c8ee91] [e_b52346f0801b].
Constellate computed that the two conditions share this causal gene, at confidence 0.9 [e_07b1ff151b14].
That shared-gene link is inferred, meaning it was calculated and is not a separate database finding [e_07b1ff151b14].

For the saposin B form, two observed features are recorded, worsening movement ability and damage to the coating of nerves outside the brain, each from a small report [e_765b0bd7ae9e] [e_3039823a577a].
A research grant is linked to combined PSAP deficiency, but its title is about detectors for small animal imaging, so its relevance is unclear [e_1dcc3789df64].
These edges do not show how the two conditions differ, and they list no symptoms for combined PSAP deficiency, no treatments and no studies [e_07b1ff151b14] [e_b52346f0801b].
